tool.name: OGS: createLayeredMeshFromRasters
tool.description: Galaxy wrapper for the OGS utility 'createLayeredMeshFromRasters'.
tool.command: ln -sf '$raster_list' '$raster_list.txt'; ln -sf '$input_mesh_file' '$input_mesh_file.vtu'; createLayeredMeshFromRasters $ascii_output #if str($thickness) --thickness '$thickness' #end if --raster-list '$raster_list.txt' $keep_surface_material_ids --input-mesh-file '$input_mesh_file.vtu' --output-mesh-file output_1.vtu

param.label: ascii output
param.help: Write VTU output in ASCII format.

param.label: thickness
param.help: The minimum thickness of a layer to be integrated at any given location, (min = 0)

param.label: raster list
param.help: Input (.vtu). An ascii-file containing a list of input raster files, starting from top (DEM) to bottom

param.label: keep surface material ids
param.help: if the argument is present the materials defined in the surface mesh are used to set the material information for the subsurface cells

param.label: input mesh file
param.help: Input (.vtu). The file name of the 2D input mesh

tool.help: This tool runs the **createLayeredMeshFromRasters** utility from the OpenGeoSys suite.
